title: SCREEN SHAKE FOLLOWS THE FIGHT
why: His answer 38 (2026-10-12): screen shake from light to strong depending on damage taken and how often it comes in. The size of a hit already set the shake, but how often hits came in did not, so the fifth round of a burst shook the screen no more than one stray round. Now the damage of the last second or so builds up: a lone graze is a nudge, a heavy hit is strong, and a burst of hits shakes harder with each one, up to a cap. It settles again within a second or two of the last hit.
now: Screen shake now grows with the size of each hit and how fast the hits are coming.
